messages.plaintextBody:
Yes — clause 9 of the service agreement lets you require garden leave during notice, salary and benefits continuing. Send him a short letter confirming garden leave from 6 February, that he remains an employee bound by his duties, and that he must not contact clients or staff or access Group systems. Tom will send you a template within the hour.

Sarah
